def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    targets = [
        ('sage60_left_top_filleted', LEFT_GEOMETRY, 'LEFT_PLATE_SURFACE_FILLETED'),
        ('sage60_right_top_filleted', RIGHT_GEOMETRY, 'RIGHT_TB_PLATE_SURFACE_FILLETED'),
    ]
    result = []
    for doc_name, geometry_path, sketch_name in targets:
        # Reuse an already-open generated document if this script is run again.
        doc = None
        for i in range(app.documents.count):
            candidate = app.documents.item(i)
            if candidate.name == doc_name:
                doc = candidate
                break
        if doc is None:
            doc = app.documents.add(adsk.core.DocumentTypes.FusionDesignDocumentType)
            doc.name = doc_name
        doc.activate()
        design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        root = design.rootComponent
        for i in range(root.sketches.count - 1, -1, -1):
            if root.sketches.item(i).name == sketch_name:
                root.sketches.item(i).deleteMe()
        sketch, outer_count = make_sketch(root, geometry_path, sketch_name)
        result.append({'document': doc.name, 'sketch': sketch.name, 'outer_segments': outer_count, 'lines': sketch.sketchCurves.sketchLines.count, 'arcs': sketch.sketchCurves.sketchArcs.count, 'circles': sketch.sketchCurves.sketchCircles.count, 'profiles': sketch.profiles.count, 'bodies': [body.name for body in root.bRepBodies], 'isSaved': bool(doc.isSaved)})
    # Leave the right-hand document active for an immediate visual check.
    for i in range(app.documents.count):
        if app.documents.item(i).name == 'sage60_right_top_filleted':
            app.documents.item(i).activate()
            app.activeViewport.fit()
            break
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
